claims.claim: Badger Meter is broadening from smart metering into continuous sewer-network monitoring: it completed the UDlive acquisition in May 2026, adding UK hardware-enabled software capability alongside SmartCover in the BlueEdge portfolio.

risks.risk: Acquisition-led expansion adds integration and valuation risk and does not guarantee cross-sell or recurring-software growth.

unknowns.unknown: UDlive's standalone revenue, margins, retention and realized cross-sell contribution are not quantified in this source.

claims.claim: FY2025 sales reached a record $916.7 million, operating earnings rose 16% to $183.4 million, operating margin reached 20.0%, SaaS sales grew 27% to about $74 million and operating cash flow reached a record $183.7 million; management entered 2026 targeting high-single-digit five-year sales growth, annual operating-margin expansion and free-cash-flow conversion above 100% of earnings.

risks.risk: Management explicitly expected project-pacing effects to pressure base revenue growth through the first half of 2026; project timing can create quarter-to-quarter unevenness.

unknowns.unknown: Current 2026 year-to-date organic growth and margin performance need the latest quarterly release for direct comparison with the five-year ambition.
